headline: News of Acquisition of Eramet Shares with Haji Isam, VKTR Speaks Up
summary: VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas denied involvement in a consortium reportedly planning to acquire shares of Eramet linked to Weda Bay Nickel. The report concerns an Indonesian nickel asset.
why: Eramet is a French mining group that holds an interest in Weda Bay Nickel, a major nickel project in Indonesia used in battery supply chains.
original_headline: Kabar Mau Akuisisi Saham Eramet Bareng Haji Isam, VKTR Buka Suara
